An internal check failed: a response from the cell exceeds the transport size limit. Collect the logs and report it.

The Program needs a cell capability that the active Deployment does not offer. Add a component that offers it to the Deployment and Apply.

column2: Scenario change refused: a Stop outcome is uncertain
column3: New, Load or Apply was refused because the outcome of a stopped motion is uncertain. Check the robot before trying again.

column2: Scenario change refused: motion still in progress
column3: New, Load or Apply was refused because a motion is still queued, running or stopping. Stop it, wait until it has ended, then try again.
An internal check failed: a cell identity is missing or invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
The candidate configuration has a different cell ID than the running one, so the runtime change was refused. Keep the cell ID unchanged when applying.

column2: Cell latched: a component needs attention
column3: A component is in fault, offline or cannot report whether it is still moving, so the cell refuses Program run and resume, every node, manual motion and manual I/O. Fix the component with its own actions (Prepare, Enable, Recover); the latch clears by itself when every component is healthy and idle.

column2: Cell launch files unsafe or changed
column3: The launcher found the cell's launch state files missing, unsafe or replaced while opening them. Check the launcher state directory and start the cell again.
Status or stop needs a cell started by the launcher, and none was found for this instance. Check the instance id and state directory.
The operator-alarm attention data belongs to another cell, so attention is unavailable.
A certified-containment reset named a subordinate execution that is no longer current. Refresh the state and try again.
The cell admission has no room left for another claim. Wait for running work to finish and try again.
An internal check failed: a cell admission claim has an invalid owner, transaction, request, payload digest or generation. Collect the logs and report it.
The release came from an owner generation that is no longer current, so it was refused. Refresh the state and try again.
The release does not match the held claim or its settlement kind, so it was refused. Refresh the state and try again.
The lower bound of clamp() is greater than its upper bound. Correct the expression.
One or more launched processes were still running after the launcher's cleanup time ran out. Check the robot, stop the remaining processes and run the launcher stop again.
An internal check failed: a coherent frame capture was read without a time binding, which it does not serve. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Coherent capture read at wrong time
column3: An internal check failed: a coherent frame capture was read at a time other than its own evaluation time. Collect the logs and report it.
The referenced collision body is not present in the applied component model.

column2: Collision body is not available to this target
column3: Choose a collision body mounted on the selected target.
The collision world for the contact check is missing or outdated, so the contact input is unavailable. Check the Scene and its collision components.
The contact bodies could not be matched to the prepared collision geometry, so the contact input is unavailable. Check the Scene and the component that owns the contact bodies.
The collision-policy projection is not installed in this runtime. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a collision policy revision number is out of range. Collect the logs and report it.
The trajectory could not be expanded for collision validation because of an unexpected error; the details give it. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Start state unfit for collision check
column3: The observed start state does not have the number of positions needed to seed the full collision coordinates. Check the robot's joint state and try again.
The previous collision check has not finished, so this contact sample is unavailable. The next sample is scheduled as usual.
The collision check failed or returned a result that cannot be used, so the contact input is unavailable for this sample.
The collision engine could not prepare its check for the robot's joints, so the contact input is unavailable. Check the collision engine and the robot model.

column2: Collision engine missing in new resources
column3: An internal check failed: the new collision resources lack a required collision engine. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the capabilities of the new collision engines could not be verified. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the new collision engines cannot be used independently for their roles. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the new collision resources did not provide a complete collision world. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the collision resource change counter reached its limit. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Collision resources busy: cell not idle
column3: The collision resources could not be replaced because the cell is not idle. Wait until motion has finished and try again.
The collision resources could not be replaced while the motion controller is resetting or shutting down. Try again when it has finished.
The collision resources could not be replaced while collision look-ahead checks are running. Wait until motion has finished and try again.
An internal check failed: the new look-ahead collision engines do not match the configured worker count. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the collision look-ahead session for the new collision resources could not be prepared. Collect the logs and report it.
The collision resources could not be replaced while a prepared operation is held. Finish or cancel it and try again.
An internal check failed: the new look-ahead collision resources have no motion progress source. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the new collision resources have no collision world publisher. Collect the logs and report it.
The collision resources could not be replaced while runtime collision monitoring is active. Wait until motion has finished and try again.
Collision resources have not been installed yet. Wait until the cell is ready and try again.
The collision resources could not be replaced while a motion is being checked for collisions. Wait until it has finished and try again.
An internal check failed: the new collision validation engines do not match the configured worker count. Collect the logs and report it.
The collision check of the motion was cancelled before it finished, so the motion was not validated.

column2: Collision check fallback raised an error
column3: An internal check failed: the serial fallback of the collision check raised an error, so the motion was not validated. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the motion trajectory could not be sampled for its collision check. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Collision check worker raised an error
column3: An internal check failed: a collision check worker raised an error, so the motion was not validated. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a collision world revision number is out of range. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a prepared motion refers to two different collision world versions. Collect the logs and report it.
The collision world snapshot publisher failed with an unexpected error. Collect the logs and report it.
No collision world snapshot is available, so collision checking cannot run. Check that the scene is loaded and try again.
An internal check failed: a prepared command has a missing or oversized channel binding list. Collect the logs and report it.
The commanded trajectory position at the start of the Stop is outside the accepted trajectory, so the Stop cannot follow its path. The planner recommends a hard Stop instead.
The gripper backend refused to attach the command estimate to the gripper command, so the command was aborted. Check the gripper and its controller.
This command is not allowed in the current state.
The command carries an option its schema does not declare. Remove the option from the command.
An internal check failed: a prepared command has a missing or oversized option list. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a prepared command has a missing or oversized resource binding list. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a prepared command has a missing or unsupported completion or confirmation rule. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the prepared command names Stop evidence it cannot use. Collect the logs and report it.
The Program names a command target that the component does not have. Choose a target that the component offers.
An internal check failed: the commanded start pose for the simulator is not finite or has nonzero velocities. Collect the logs and report it.
An action is already running on this component; wait for it to finish.
A Stop interrupted the component action in progress.
The component action's result didn't come back; it isn't resent. Check the component state.
The component refused the action before anything was sent to it; the message says why. Check the component state and try again.
The component accepted the action, but its reported state didn't show the result within the lifecycle command time. Check the component state and try again.

column2: Action not supported by this component
column3: This component doesn't support the requested action.
The component's adapter refused its model lane row or settings; the details name the problem. Correct the component's lane row or settings, then Apply.
An installed adapter library couldn't be loaded or doesn't export its adapter family. Check the installation; the details name the library.
No installed adapter handles the adapter family the component's lane row names. Check the model's lanes row or install the adapter.
A Scenario tool is not mounted from a free robot flange, sets its own cell pose, or the tool role selects no mounted tool. Correct the tool's attachment.

The configuration attaches components in an invalid way, such as a component attached to itself, twice, or in a loop, or names a collision-exclusion link its model lacks. Correct the attachments and try again.
The component has TCPs on more than one target and its type sets no single default. Choose the component's default TCP in the Deployment.
The chosen default TCP is not a TCP of the component's targets. Choose one of its TCPs.
The component's driver process couldn't be restarted; the details give the reason. Check the driver, then Prepare.
The component is enabled, so Prepare doesn't apply. Disable it first.
The folder already holds a component descriptor, so no new one was created.
The component frame lookup request is invalid. Correct the exact reference and try again.
The applied bundle or graph changed before the lookup. Refresh the capture and try again.
A model asset or component type file for this component is missing. Run the component generation step again.
A component changed while the Apply was starting its components, so the Apply could not continue.
A group role names a group the robot's SRDF does not have. Correct the component descriptor.
The component's controller topic has no publisher yet, so the action was not sent. Check that the component's driver or controller is running, then try again.

column2: Initial joint positions do not match
column3: The initial joint positions do not match the number of arm joints. Correct the component descriptor.
A joint role names a joint that is missing, fixed or mimic in the model. Correct the component descriptor.
The Mock controller row is invalid, a robot has no arm controller, or a tool has one. Correct the component descriptor.
The component's model needs a lane (mock, isaac or real) and the Deployment names none. Choose a lane for the component.
This component has no model, so it takes no lane. Remove the lane from the component.

column2: Lane not offered by this model
column3: The component names a lane its model doesn't offer. Choose one of the model's lanes.
The component's launch did not finish starting its controllers within its start-up time, so it was not prepared. Check the component's launch output, then Prepare it again.
An internal check failed: a component lifecycle request was reported as an error. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a lifecycle request could not be accepted because its values are out of range. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the accepted lifecycle request did not form a valid result. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Lifecycle catalog does not match driver
column3: An internal check failed: a component's lifecycle catalog does not match its driver. Collect the logs and report it.
The component's controllers or configuration changed since this request was prepared, so it was refused. Refresh the view and try again.
The component changed since its state was read, so the request was refused. Refresh the view and try again.

column2: Lifecycle step ran out of time
column3: The lifecycle request ran out of time before its step was sent to the component. Check the component state and try again.
The component may have changed, but the result of the lifecycle step is unknown. The cell checks the component's actual state; review it before sending further requests.
The component changed while its state was being read. Refresh the view to read it again.
The component changed but did not reach the requested state. Check the component before sending another request.
The result of the lifecycle step was uncertain, but a fresh check showed the component did not change.

column2: Lifecycle catalog not reloaded after restart
column3: An internal check failed: after a restart, a component's lifecycle catalog could not be reloaded. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: after a restart, the component state could not be read to check an interrupted request. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Component driver not found after restart
column3: An internal check failed: after a restart, a component's driver could not be found to check an interrupted request. Collect the logs and report it.
The current state of this component could not be established, so the lifecycle request was refused.
The component's current state could not be read from fresh fault-free reports and was recorded as Declared. Check the component before using it.
A lifecycle step of this component is still in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.

column2: No lifecycle step fits the component state
column3: The component's reported state allows no lifecycle step toward the requested state. Check the component.
A default or Scenario TCP speed is above the component's maximum TCP speed. Lower it to the limit or below.

column2: Component state has no model projection
column3: An internal check failed: component-local state has no kinematic model to project into or to be seeded from. Collect the logs and report it.
A field of the component descriptor is missing, unknown or malformed, or the YAML is invalid. The message names the field.
A mesh path is outside the component's package folder or the file does not exist. Correct the mesh path.
The component's URDF or SRDF could not be read. Check the model files.

column2: Robot is still moving on its own
column3: The robot is still moving under its own controller, so the command was refused before any effect. Press again once the robot has stopped.
The component isn't enabled, so it doesn't accept commands. Enable it first.
The requested component isn't in the cell.
The component must be prepared before it can be enabled. Prepare it first.
The component's ROS connection is closing, being rebuilt or still recovering, so the request was not sent. Wait until the component is ready, then try again.
The robot or tool rows for this component are missing. Register the component.
{component} has not finished an internal task ({task}) for over 4 s. Execution is blocked.
Two component folders have the same id and version but different content. Remove one or change its version.
The component's process couldn't be started; the details give the reason. Check the installation, then Prepare.
The component process Stop ended in a way that cannot be confirmed, so its outcome is unknown. Check the component and the robot before any further motion.

column2: Process Stop has no managed host
column3: The process Stop could not reach the managed host that started the component, so the stop is not confirmed. Check the component's process before sending more requests.
The component process Stop is still waiting for its reply. Wait for it to settle before continuing.

column2: Component stop reply not received yet
column3: The component process Stop has not replied yet. Wait for it to settle before continuing.
The result of the earlier component Stop is missing or was replaced by a later Stop, so it cannot be read again. Check the component's state before continuing.
The component's command readiness changed while physical work was still resident. Wait for the work to finish and try again.
The component's command readiness changed while physical resources were still reserved. Wait for the resources to be released and try again.

column2: Controller didn't come back from its reboot
column3: The robot controller didn't answer again within the reboot wait. Check the control box, then Prepare.
The component's controller is rebooting. Prepare it once it is back.
The causes changed since you confirmed them, so nothing more was run. Review them and confirm again.
The referenced component is not present in the applied bundle.
The registered rows of this robot or tool differ from its descriptor. Register the component again.
A frame, collision, TCP, mount, attach or touch link role names a link the URDF does not have. Correct the component descriptor.

column2: Speed scaling declaration differs from controller
column3: The robot's lane row declares runtime_scale, but the arm controller its adapter generates does not match it (only a controller that commands position alone accepts runtime speed scaling), so the Scenario was not loaded. Correct the model's lane row or its controllers.
A Scenario's component of this robot or tool does not match its descriptor. Update the Scenario or the component.
The runtime schema does not accept this component's Mock profile yet. Complete the component setup steps.
The gripper group lacks an open or closed state, or the descriptor names a missing one. Correct the component descriptor.
A data stream this component needs has not been received. Check that the component and its driver or simulation are running.
A data stream of this component went stale, and the condition holds until acknowledged. Check the source, then Recover the component.
A data stream this component needs stopped updating in time. Check that the component and its driver or simulation are running.
The launch could not confirm that all its owned processes are present and ready, so it is degraded. The details give the reason.
A component in the cell isn't healthy; fix it before running.
Composer does not own a runtime, so this action is unavailable. Configure the headless API to issue the owner's runtime and try again.

column2: Applied Program is not valid here
column3: The Applied Program does not validate against the current nodes, so the Draft could not return to it. The details name the problem.
A Program node has more children than it accepts. Remove the extra children.
An internal check failed: the cell API reply to a Program edit omitted its authoring claim, so the edit was refused. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an accepted Manager operation did not take over the exact local authoring claim. Collect the logs and report it.
The cell API could not confirm the authoring claim of a Program edit, so Program edits are refused. Check that the workbench is running; collect the logs and report it if edits stay refused.
The Program Draft has errors and cannot be applied. Fix the problems listed in the details.
A field of a Program node is invalid. The details name the field.
The Program tree contains a repeated node or a container cycle. Remove the repetition.
The Program tree is nested deeper than allowed. Flatten it.
The Program tree has an unsupported format or shape.
The Program has more nodes than allowed. Remove nodes or split the Program.
An internal check failed: the Program editor sent an edit kind the server does not support. Collect the logs and report it.
Two Program nodes have the same identity. The details name the node.
A Program node is malformed: its id or children are missing or invalid. The details name the node.
A Program node type is not in the active node catalog. Remove the node or install its package.
An internal check failed: the cell API settled a Program edit without its admission generation, so Program edits are refused. Collect the logs and report it.
A Program node sets parameters it does not have. The details name them.
The Program editor layout positions are invalid or name unknown nodes.
Edits are refused because the authoring state could not be confirmed. The details give the reason; collect the logs and report it if it does not clear.
An internal check failed: the cell API returned a malformed or ambiguous authoring owner inventory, so Program edits are refused. Collect the logs and report it.
The cell API could not settle the authoring claim of a Program edit, so Program edits are refused. Check that the workbench is running; collect the logs and report it if edits stay refused.
A node's value source path is invalid. The details name the node and the path.
The active node catalog does not define the pose-authoring input contract, so pose fields cannot be checked. Check the installed node packages; if they are complete, collect the logs and report it.
This would discard unapplied or unsaved Draft changes. Confirm to discard them, or save or Apply first.
The request's Draft identity is missing or malformed. Refresh the Draft and try again.
The request names a Draft that has since been replaced. Refresh the Draft and try again.
An internal check failed: a section of the Program Draft has the wrong shape. Collect the logs and report it.
The Draft's revision counter is at its maximum, so it cannot record another change. This should not happen in normal use; collect the logs and report it.
The request's Draft revision is not a non-negative whole number. Refresh the Draft and try again.
The Draft changed after the request was made, so the edit was refused. Review the current Draft and try again.
The Draft edit tool named in the request does not exist. Use one of the supported Draft edit tools.
There is no Program Draft loaded. Open or create a Program first.

column2: Draft does not make a valid Program
column3: The Draft, or the requested change to it, does not give a valid Program candidate, so the request was refused. The details name the problem; if they say the candidate is inconsistent, collect the logs and report it.
Composer failed unexpectedly while handling this request. Collect the logs and report it.
The request sent to the Composer is larger than the allowed size and was refused. Reduce the content (for example a smaller file) and try again.
An internal check failed: the retained Program Draft state has an invalid shape or inconsistent identities. Collect the logs and report it.
The Program has no file path yet, so Save needs one. Use Save As to choose where to save it.
The Composer holds no saved Program for this action. Save the Program first.
The Composer settings file could not be used; defaults are in use and settings are read-only. Reset settings to start again; the old file is kept as a backup.
This Composer has no settings location, so settings are not saved and defaults are in use.
The settings file is readable, so it was not reset. Use Restore defaults instead.
The settings could not be written to disk and were not changed. Check the free space and permissions of the settings location.
The maximum number of settings profiles is already saved. Delete a profile or replace an existing one.
A profile name has 1-64 letters, digits, spaces, '.', '_' or '-', and starts with a letter or digit.
No settings profile with this name exists. Refresh the settings and choose an existing profile.
The settings were changed elsewhere and this change was not saved. Review the current settings and make the change again.
A Draft's identity changed during one edit, so editing is blocked. Restart the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.

column2: Program editing blocked after an error
column3: Program editing is blocked because an earlier change broke an internal rule. Restart the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.

column2: Editing blocked after a failed update
column3: An internal workspace update broke its rules, so editing is blocked. Restart the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.

column2: Editing blocked after a failed update
column3: An internal workspace update failed, so editing is blocked. Restart the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.

column2: Editing blocked after a failed update
column3: An internal workspace update changed more than it should, so editing is blocked. Restart the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the replacement Scenario project data has an invalid shape. Collect the logs and report it.
The workspace reached its edit limit. Restart the Composer backend and reload the saved project.
The Program workspace kept changing while it was being read. Try again.
The Composer workspace changed while this request was made. Refresh and try again.
The completed computation was acknowledged and the cell returned to Idle. No action needed.
The pose source found the object, but the detection score is below the configured minimum confidence. Check the detector or lower the minimum confidence.
An internal check failed: the Apply record does not match its claim. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an Apply claim is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
Cell authoring is not ready for the configuration Apply: its components, Deployment, Program cycle or Manager liveness are not all current. Check the cell status, then Apply again.
The durable record of the Apply claim does not match the claim being used. Collect the logs and report it.
Cell authoring is not ready for the configuration Apply: a claim held by another owner is still open. Check the cell status, then Apply again.
An internal check failed: an Apply that should be finished has no recorded outcome. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a successful Apply was not recorded as finished. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the record of the original Apply is missing. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the status of the original Apply is missing. Collect the logs and report it.
The Manager could not read the record of a previous Apply. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an Apply claim was requested without its validator or with unsupported evidence. Collect the logs and report it.
Operation admission is closed by a configuration fence while the configuration changes. Wait for the change to finish and try again.
An internal check failed: a collision resource change named an invalid configuration hold. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration hold of the motion controller is unavailable. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a collision resource change was requested without the configuration hold. Collect the logs and report it.
The configuration hold could not be restored after a restart: it is missing, conflicting, or the cell is not idle. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a configuration hold request names another or already released hold. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration hold could not be verified. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal or contact provider was given an invalid configuration and did not start. Collect the logs and report it.
The Alarm Lifecycle Owner has not yet observed the Kernel's active configuration, so operator alarm attention is unavailable until it catches up.
An internal check failed: the query for the parent Apply's recovery receipt is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
The configuration change could not be prepared.
The new configuration could not be published.
The new configuration could not be published completely; its effects are unknown. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a cell admission configuration scope has invalid identities or generations, or is not in canonical order. Collect the logs and report it.
The new configuration could not be confirmed.

column2: Robot has no measured joint geometry
column3: An internal check failed: a configured robot has no measured joint resources for its geometry. Collect the logs and report it.
The measured position of the robot is not available from its configured source. Check that the robot component is Active and reporting.
An internal check failed: the list of configured robots has an empty or duplicate entry. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an observed-state source names a component that is not a configured robot. Collect the logs and report it.
This Apply has effects that must be confirmed first. Review the preview and confirm it.
The Apply impact changed after it was previewed and confirmed. Preview and confirm again.
An internal check failed: the Scene start-up was asked to finalize an empty Scene that was already finalized. Collect the logs and report it.
The motion touches the grasp target before the terminal window in which grasp contact is allowed, so it is refused. Correct the path or the contact policy.
The contact input is unavailable because a contact body is static in the collision world.

column2: Contact grasp has no robot bodies
column3: An internal check failed: the contact-grasp policy resolved no robot collision bodies. Collect the logs and report it.
The contact-grasp policy needs a resolved motion endpoint and has none. Check the motion's target and the policy.
A contact-grasp robot body differs from the retained collision world. Refresh the scene and try again.
The resolved contact-grasp object differs from the one in the operation intent. Select the object again and retry.
The contact-grasp policy has no selected runtime object. Select the object to grasp, or run the detection before it.
The selected contact-grasp object is missing from the scene, already carried, or has no shape. Check the scene and the object.
The selected contact-grasp object differs from the retained collision world. Refresh the scene and try again.
A contact penetrated deeper than the contact policy allows. Adjust the approach or the policy limit.
The motion touches something its contact policy does not allow. Change the path or the contact policy.
An internal check failed: the entering contact-release state does not match the policy's support contacts. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the entering contact-release state lacks its initial depth. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the contact-release evidence has no final sample. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the contact-release evidence has no sample at the first waypoint. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the contact-release state has no initial depth. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the contact-release summary for a contact pair is missing. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a contact-release violation names a policy entry that does not exist. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the waypoint record for a contact-release violation is missing. Collect the logs and report it.
Isaac Sim cannot start without the full ROS container configuration. Complete the launcher profile and try again.

column2: Runtime container does not match launch
column3: The remote runtime container is not the one this launch created. Stop the cell with the launcher and start it again.
An internal check failed: continuous measured robot state needs exactly one joint-state source with measured authority and a freshness limit. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the control bindings of the configuration are invalid or exceed their limit. Collect the logs and report it.
The control state changed since the recovery was requested, so nothing was done. Refresh the recovery view and try again.
The control file watch is not current, so the control state cannot be reported. Wait a moment; if it persists, check the control file and collect the logs.
The command was refused because the view it was based on is too old. Refresh and send the command again.
An internal check failed: a command carried malformed or unsigned freshness data. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the backend clock value is out of range. Collect the logs and report it.
The control service restarted or its owner changed during this control session, so the client must refresh its view before it sends commands.

column2: Prepared operation has no control path
column3: An internal check failed: a prepared operation has no control path for its component. Collect the logs and report it.
The command was refused because the cell state changed after the view it was based on. Check the current state and send the command again.
The control projection is still synchronizing with the runtime. Wait a moment and try again.
The current component overview could not be read from the cell.
The command was refused because the control service restarted after the view it was based on. Refresh and send the command again.
An internal check failed: the control command counter could not rotate while sessions or commands were active. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the control command counter reached its limit and must rotate when the cell is quiet. Collect the logs and report it.
The control session closed, so its open heartbeat incidents were resolved.
An internal check failed: the controlled hard Stop brake input does not give one reference position and velocity per joint. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Controlled Stop replaced by controller cancel
column3: The controller reports a speed factor of 0, so the Stop was carried out as a controller cancel instead of a controlled Stop. Check the robot before any further motion.

column2: No time left for a controlled Stop
column3: The Stop deadline left no time for another controlled Stop mode. Check the robot before any further motion.

column2: Controlled Stop not possible at this speed factor
column3: A controlled Stop ramp could not be computed at the current speed factor. Check the robot before any further motion.
The controlled Stop has no jerk choice or angular jerk limits prepared for this motion. Check the robot's Stop settings and Apply again.
Every configured controlled Stop mode was tried or could not be used. Check the robot before any further motion.

column2: Controlled Stop not observed by controller
column3: No controller sample confirmed the controlled Stop before the Stop deadline. Check the robot before any further motion.

column2: Controlled Stop could not be planned
column3: No controlled Stop path could be planned from the current robot state. Check the robot before any further motion.
The execution backend does not implement a controlled Stop, so the Stop could not be confirmed by the backend. Check the robot; this backend only supports the hard Stop.
An internal check failed: the configured trajectory action name does not match the controller binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the controller binding snapshot belongs to a different contract than the one in force. Collect the logs and report it.
The controller binding changed after the trajectory was dispatched, so the motion was refused. Try the motion again.

column2: Controller binding not valid for motion
column3: The controller binding is not valid for motion. Check the reasons the controller component reports, then try again.
The connection to the robot controller was lost after a motion was dispatched. A stop was requested, but the controller did not confirm it. Check the robot before any further motion.
The robot controller refused its binding before any goal was sent, so the motion did not start.
The controller binding snapshot is too old to use for motion. Wait for the controller component's status to refresh, then try again.

An internal check failed: a participant lost its prepared product after the coordinated barrier was complete. Collect the logs and report it.

The pose source reported a position uncertainty above the configured maximum. Check the sensor or raise the allowed variance.
A runtime report's critical progress sequence is lower than the last one accepted for this component, so the report was rejected.

column2: Robot has no active control route

The component must name exactly one of its TCPs as default. Correct its TCP list.

column2: Not a part of this machine

An internal check failed: a robot geometry source has joints with missing, mismatched or repeated coordinates. Collect the logs and report it.

Whether a component of this Apply was started is unknown, so the Apply was stopped. Check the component state.

An internal check failed: an I/O device output has no signals, repeats a resource or has no provider. Collect the logs and report it.

An internal check failed: a signal record request asked for an invalid range. Collect the logs and report it.
Every sender of this I/O device's inputs has left the network, so its input values are no longer current. Check the device, its bridge and the network; once it sends again, Recover the device.
The global interrupt rules changed while they were being activated, so the activation was refused. Apply again.

column2: Global rules waiting for a configuration change
column3: Another configuration change is in progress, so the global interrupt rules could not be applied yet. Apply again when it finishes.

column2: Global rules differ from the staged set
column3: Another set of global interrupt rules is already staged and differs from this one. Wait for that Apply to finish, then Apply again.
The global interrupt rules changed during this Apply, so they were not installed. Apply again.
An internal check failed: a global interrupt rule candidate is malformed or has an invalid context. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Global rule parent configuration not held
column3: An internal check failed: the configuration that a global interrupt rule candidate depends on is not held. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Global rule candidate out of date
column3: The global interrupt rules being applied changed underneath it, so the candidate was refused. Apply again.
A global interrupt rule cannot watch its signals, so the motion was stopped. Check the I/O component that provides them.
An internal check failed: the global interrupt rule catalog does not match its service. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a global interrupt rule definition is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a global interrupt rule's execution group scope is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a subject of a global interrupt rule's execution group scope is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Program value keys read by global interrupt rules do not match the referenced keys. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the global interrupt rules do not all have an owner to arm them. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the global activation release differs from its actual parent. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Global rule state record out of order
column3: An internal check failed: a global interrupt rule state change was recorded out of order. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: recording a global interrupt rule state change raised an error. Collect the logs and report it.
The trip evidence of a global interrupt rule changed while its Stop response was being checked, so the response was refused.
An internal check failed: the operations selected for a global interrupt rule Stop are empty, unordered or repeated. Collect the logs and report it.
The motion or operation a global interrupt rule was going to stop changed or ended before its Stop response was made, so the response was refused.
The Stop plan of a global interrupt rule changed before its Stop response was made, so the response was refused.
The policy of a global interrupt rule changed before its Stop response was made, so the response was refused.

column2: Global rules changed before Stop response
column3: The global interrupt rules changed before their Stop response was made, so the response was refused.
An internal check failed: global interrupt rules were restored while other configuration work could still change them. Collect the logs and report it.
A global guard cannot request a Mock search answer, so the rule was refused. Remove the search expectation from the guard.
An internal check failed: the I/O signal service does not belong to the applied owner epoch or has no catalog. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the I/O signal service used for global interrupt rules is not the expected one. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration has I/O signals or Program values but no I/O signal service for global interrupt rules. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: No terminal Apply for global rules
column3: The global activation has no actual terminal Apply, so the request was refused. Apply again.
An internal check failed: a global interrupt rule that waits for Program values has an invalid definition. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Global rule waits for Program values
column3: The global interrupt rule needs values from the Program before it can watch. It starts watching once the Program publishes them.
An internal check failed: a signal source reported message loss inconsistently. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Input signal has an output resource
column3: An internal check failed: an input signal was registered with an output resource. Collect the logs and report it.
The input signal has no fresh value, so the step cannot read it. Check the device that sends the signal, then try again.
Manual output writes wait until no motion is executing. Stop or wait for the motion to finish, then write the output.
An internal check failed: a Mock input echoes to an output signal that the configuration does not have. Collect the logs and report it.
The device didn't confirm whether it accepted the output write; it isn't resent. The output stays unknown until the device reports it.

column2: Output aliases changed before the change
column3: The output alias change was refused because the output aliases changed after it was prepared. Nothing was changed; refresh the output components and try again.
The output alias change was refused as stale: its output channel is retired, or it is older than the current output publication. Nothing was changed; refresh and try again.

column2: Output has no outside-change signal at Apply
column3: Apply refused the condition: this output is controller-owned or has no read-back, so it has no changed_outside signal. Use an output with read-back.
An internal check failed: an output signal was registered without a valid output resource. Collect the logs and report it.
This output has a controller function configured, so ManyForge can't set it.
The output Enable or Disable was refused as stale: a newer or already applied command holds this output, or its driver was retired. Nothing was changed.
The output alias change was refused because one of its output drivers has been retired. Nothing was changed; check the output components and try again.
The output command was refused before it was sent, for example because the output provider is disabled. The details give the reason; check that the provider component is Active.
An internal check failed: an output shutdown names an output that this provider does not have configured. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an output alias change reused the current publication with different aliases. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an output alias change was sent without a valid publication. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Output write refused by the device
column3: The device refused the output write; the details give its reason.
The device refused the output write; the details give its return code.
An internal check failed: one I/O provider group covers signals of different components. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O device configuration is malformed or too large. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O device's output acknowledgement timeout is not a positive, finite duration. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: I/O device output timeout missing or unused
column3: An internal check failed: an I/O device's output acknowledgement timeout is missing on a ROS output device or present on another device. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O device has an output acknowledgement timeout but is not a ROS output device. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the I/O provider device settings do not cover exactly the provider groups. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O provider group has no device settings. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a derived I/O provider control domain is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Control domain is not an I/O provider
column3: An internal check failed: a control domain expected to be an I/O provider is not one. Collect the logs and report it.
The I/O provider domains differ from the actual ownership, so the request was refused. Check the I/O provider configuration, then Apply.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal endpoint is owned by a different runtime unit than its signal. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal endpoint uses a role its runtime profile does not offer. Collect the logs and report it.
The lifecycle catalog of an I/O provider in this configuration is not valid. Check the I/O component package or report it.
An I/O provider in this configuration has no lifecycle manifest installed. Check that its package is installed or report it.
An internal check failed: the same I/O provider manifest revision is listed twice. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: I/O provider manifest does not offer signals
column3: An internal check failed: an I/O provider binding uses a manifest that does not offer the I/O signal service. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: one I/O signal resolves to more than one provider. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal resolves to no provider. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal names a runtime unit that is not in the cell graph. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the same runtime profile revision is listed twice. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O provider's signal list is malformed or does not match its signals. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O provider configuration has no signal list. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O provider binding names an invalid target. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal sample carries a receive time that is negative or in the future. Collect the logs and report it.
A signal sample carries an earlier receive time than the previous sample from its source, so it was refused.

column2: ROS I/O connection on a controlled component
column3: A ROS I/O connection signal is placed on a component that also has a robot or tool controller binding. Put the ROS I/O connection on its own component and Apply again.
The I/O rule activation mode is not implemented, so the rule was refused. Choose another activation mode.
The I/O rule condition was already active when it was armed, so the start was refused. Clear the condition, then try again.

column2: Interrupt rule armed for wrong scope
column3: An internal check failed: an interrupt rule was armed for a different scope, policy or owner than requested. Collect the logs and report it.
An interrupt rule reads a Program value, but its current baseline is unavailable. Check that the Applied Program and its values are available.

column2: Rule key does not match Program values
column3: An internal check failed: an interrupt rule key does not match the Program's published values. Collect the logs and report it.
The processing of the affected I/O rules could not be queued. Collect the logs and report it.
A configured operation fault rule matched, so the operation ended as failed. Check the cause named by the rule.
The interrupt rule was registered again before this request was handled. Refresh the view and try again.

column2: Motion interrupt rules changed before start
column3: The motion's interrupt rules changed while it was being prepared, so the motion did not start. Try again.

column2: Motion ended on its own during interrupt Stop
column3: The motion finished on its own during an interrupt Stop, which its Stop profile does not allow, so the motion failed. Check the robot, then Reset.
The motion finished on its own during an interrupt Stop without proof that the Stop completed, so the motion failed. Check the robot, then Reset.
The interrupt Stop could not be confirmed as completed, so the motion failed. Check the robot, then Reset.
An internal check failed: the evidence needed to order interrupt rule stops is missing. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt rule has no recorded outcome. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion's participant for an interrupt rule is missing from its operation. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the prepared rule outcomes lost their exact participant rows. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt policy is not installed, or its Stop action differs from the policy. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Interrupt rule scope or policy missing
column3: An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt rule has no matching scope or policy. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt policy has no qualified semantics. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Interrupt scopes do not match prepared motion
column3: An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt scopes do not match its prepared scopes. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion's interrupt Stop response does not match its prepared Stop plan. Collect the logs and report it.
The interrupt rule was retired before this request was handled. Refresh the view and try again.
An internal check failed: an interrupt rule registration is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
The Stop requested by an interrupt rule was not proved to have started, so the operation failed. Check the robot before any further motion.
A required interrupt source failed during the operation, so the operation stopped. Check the I/O component that provides the source.
An internal check failed: an interrupt rule's list of required signal sources is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Rule sources do not match its condition
column3: An internal check failed: an interrupt rule's required sources differ from those its condition reads. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an interrupt response repeats an exact participant. Collect the logs and report it.
The interrupt response lost its compiled action because the policy changed, so it was refused. Apply again.
The interrupt cannot replace the current logical Stop owner because its priority is not higher. No action needed.
The interrupt response lost its exact prepared owner, so it was refused. Apply again.
The interrupt rule now belongs to a different motion scope than this request expected. Refresh the view and try again.
An internal check failed: a motion has interrupt rules but there is no I/O signal service. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Interrupt rule service missing on retirement
column3: An internal check failed: an interrupt rule needs retiring but there is no I/O signal service. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: I/O signal service unavailable for motion
column3: The I/O signal service is not available, so the motion's interrupt rules could not be armed and the motion did not start. Check that the I/O components are applied and Active.
The I/O rule service is not installed, so the request was refused.

column2: I/O inputs can't be disabled during a Run
column3: An I/O device's inputs cannot be disabled while a Program Run is active. Wait for the Run to end, then Disable the device again.
A signal source required by this interrupt rule is disabled. Enable the source or update the Deployment so the rule can watch it.

column2: Signal source to disable is empty
column3: An internal check failed: a request to disable signal sources names an empty source. Collect the logs and report it.
A required signal source is unavailable or its condition cannot be evaluated. Motion in the rule's scope is gated until it can watch again.
The global rule-state journal projection is not installed, so the request was refused.
The I/O rule's Stop response is missing a field or uses an unsupported value. Correct the I/O rule's Stop response in the Program, then Apply again.
An internal check failed: the prepared Stop entry of an I/O rule does not match its Stop plan. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the robot's Stop stage list has missing or duplicate stage ids. Collect the logs and report it.
An I/O rule names an empty Stop entry stage, or the robot has no usable Stop stage list. Check the rule's Stop settings and Apply again.

column2: I/O rule Stop stage cannot be entered
column3: The Stop stage chosen by an I/O rule does not exist or cannot start a Stop for this robot. Choose another Stop stage and Apply again.

column2: I/O rule Stop skips the hard Stop stage
column3: The Stop stage chosen by an I/O rule has no software hard Stop stage after it. Choose an earlier Stop stage and Apply again.

column2: I/O rule has no robot to stop
column3: An I/O rule's Stop does not apply to any robot motion in the configuration. Check the rule's targets and Apply again.
An I/O rule names an unknown Stop mode. Choose a valid Stop mode and Apply again.

column2: Stop mode not available for this robot
column3: The robot only provides hard deceleration Stop settings, so an I/O rule cannot use this Stop mode. Choose hard deceleration and Apply again.
An internal check failed: the I/O rule Stop data of the configuration does not match its robot models. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the interrupt response differs from its sealed Stop plan. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration has more than one Stop data set for a robot. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration has no Stop data for a robot used by an I/O rule. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Stop profile for an I/O rule is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
The I/O rule's Stop matches more than one control route. Correct the control binding so exactly one route is chosen, then Apply again.
The I/O rule's Stop has no control route for its binding. Check the control binding, then Apply again.

column2: I/O rule Stop setting not fixed
column3: The I/O rule's Stop mode, priority, stage or fallback outcome must be a fixed value, not an expression. Set it to a fixed value, then Apply again.
The I/O rule's Stop target matches more than one bound target. Correct the target so exactly one is bound, then Apply again.

column2: I/O rule Stop target not bound
column3: The I/O rule's Stop target is not bound to a target that can execute trajectories. Bind the target in the Program, then Apply again.

column2: I/O rule Stop success stage mismatch
column3: An internal check failed: the prepared success stage of an I/O rule does not match its Stop plan. Collect the logs and report it.
The motion went past the success threshold of the interrupt rule before the Stop completed, so the operation failed. Check the robot before any further motion.

column2: I/O rule success stage out of range
column3: The success stage of an I/O rule must lie between its Stop entry stage and the software hard Stop stage. Choose another stage and Apply again.
A matched interrupt has no nominal Stop certificate, so the operation failed. Check the robot, then collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal source delivered a malformed sample. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the I/O signal sequence space is exhausted. Collect the logs and report it.
This output is controller-owned or has no read-back, so it has no changed_outside flag to read, watch or clear. Use an output with read-back.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal row is malformed, misses a field or has an unexpected field. Collect the logs and report it.
The I/O signal contract is not implemented; only boolean signals are supported. Use a boolean signal.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal's description is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
The Mock simulation source differs from the sealed binding, so the request was refused. Apply again.
A condition or I/O query uses an output signal where an input is required, or a signal declares an unknown direction. Use an input signal.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal has an unsupported freshness setting. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an I/O signal has an invalid or duplicate identity. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal's liveness and freshness settings do not form a valid descriptor. Collect the logs and report it.
Interrupt conditions need a signal whose source reports periodically, and this signal does not. Use a signal with periodic liveness in the condition.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal has a liveness mode its provider does not support. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Signal component not owned by its unit
column3: An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal's component is not owned by its runtime unit. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal has a ROS address that is not an absolute, valid name. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal's provider selector is not valid NFC UTF-8 text. Collect the logs and report it.
The non-coordinate provider target is not bound to its sealed signal owners, so the request was refused. Check the I/O provider configuration, then Apply.
An internal check failed: a retained I/O signal uses a provider profile or setting that its provider does not support. Collect the logs and report it.
The Mock input value was not taken up by the signal service.
The I/O service does not name the current retained activation, so the request was refused. Apply again.

column2: I/O service cannot be replaced yet
column3: The I/O signal service cannot be replaced directly while the current global interrupt rules are applied; they must change through their own Apply. Apply the global rules again instead of swapping the service.

column2: I/O service in use by a Program
column3: The I/O signal service cannot be replaced while a Program run is captured and using it. Stop or finish the Program run, then try again.

column2: I/O signal service busy with interrupt rules
column3: Interrupt rules are still active, so the I/O signal service cannot be replaced. Wait for the motions they guard to finish, then Apply again.
The current configuration has no running I/O signal service, so the request was refused. Check that the I/O components are applied and Active.

column2: Signal delivered by the wrong source
column3: An internal check failed: a signal sample came from a source that does not own the signal. Collect the logs and report it.
A signal declares a transition capability or update mode that its provider does not support. Correct the signal's settings in the Deployment.
A signal or condition uses an unsupported value type; signals must be boolean and condition operands must have matching types. Correct the signal or condition.
The request or condition names a signal that has no exact binding in the configuration, or a signal is bound twice. Check the signal bindings in the Deployment.

column2: Signal not in the I/O configuration
column3: The requested signal is not part of the current I/O configuration.
An internal check failed: a signal read asked for more signals than allowed. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Signal source availability out of date
column3: The signal source's sequence changed before this availability update, so the update was refused. Refresh and try again.
An internal check failed: the I/O catalog has more signal sources than allowed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal source reported a malformed error. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal source was installed with an invalid identity. Collect the logs and report it.
The signal source was installed again, so this update from its previous installation was refused. Check the device and its I/O component.

column2: Signal source install out of date
column3: The signal source's previous installation changed during this install, so the install was refused. Apply again.
An internal check failed: a device signal operation was applied to a Program value source. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal source has no installed provider. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a signal source record limit is zero or names an unknown source. Collect the logs and report it.
A signal sample arrived with a sequence number that is not newer than the last one from its source, so it was refused.
A signal source is unavailable or its connection was replaced, so its value cannot be used. Check the device and its I/O component.
An internal check failed: an operation named a signal source that is not configured. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a simulated signal source is listed twice. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a simulated signal source is listed but owns no signals. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Signal name reserved for output flag
column3: The signal name clashes with the outside-change signal that ManyForge creates for an output. Rename the signal in the Deployment and Apply again.
The expected input level was not observed before the step's timeout (for a pneumatic gripper, its command duration), so the step failed. Check the input signal and its device.
The shared signal-watch limit was reached, so this interrupt rule cannot watch its inputs. Reduce the number of signal watches and Apply again.
A wait-for-input node asks for an edge, but only level waits on boolean signals are supported. Change the node to a level wait.
The signal watch was replaced before this request was handled. Refresh the view and try again.

column2: Program node not in this Run
column3: The signal watch names a node that the captured Program does not contain. Reload the Program and run it again.

column2: Input watch released before a match
column3: The input watch was ended by its I/O owner, for example when the owner stopped or a new configuration was applied, before the expected input level was seen, so the wait step failed.

column2: Program Run no longer watching signals
column3: The signal watches of this Program run have already been retired, so no new watch can be registered. Start a new run if you still need it.
An earlier signal watch cancellation of this run had an uncertain outcome and used up the run's bound, so no more watches are accepted. Stop the run and start it again.
An internal check failed: a signal wait was registered or released with a malformed Program node scope. Collect the logs and report it.
The installed I/O signal service cannot release signal watches by node or run. This is a configuration problem. Collect the logs and report it.
The signal watch belongs to a node attempt that has already ended, so it was refused. No action is needed; the node's next attempt registers its own watches.

column2: Signal watch belongs to another scope
column3: The signal watch no longer belongs to the scope named in this request. Refresh the view and try again.
The Isaac launch is running but did not prove that all its owned resources and the owner are ready. Check the Isaac status and logs, then restart the Isaac launch.

column2: Isaac Sim cell did not become ready
column3: The Isaac Sim launch did not reach ready in time. Check that Isaac Sim is running and reachable, then start again.
The Isaac launch did not prove all its owned resources and owner ready. Wait for Isaac to finish starting, check its logs, and restart the launch if it stays unready.
The Isaac Sim launch failed and the launcher tried to clean up. Check the launcher status and start again.
The joint goal names source joints that are missing from the robot, listed twice, or not angular. Correct the joint names in the move.
The joint limits of the robot could not be read from its model. Check that the robot description is loaded and valid, then try again.
The simulated robot's joint states lack joints the robot needs. Check that the Isaac Sim robot matches the configured robot.
The joint target lists the same joint more than once. List each joint only once.
The joint target contains no joints. Add at least one joint with its position.

column2: Joint target has an unnamed joint
column3: The joint target contains a joint with an empty name. Give every joint a name.
The joint target has a different number of joint names and positions. Give exactly one position per joint.
A joint target position is not a finite number. Enter a valid number for every joint position.
The joint states came from a different topic than the configured one. Check the joint state topic of the robot.
Detached start needs systemd-cat and the systemd journal on this host. Install or enable them, or start in the foreground.
An assistant tool argument that must hold a JSON object or array could not be read as JSON. The assistant corrects the argument and calls the tool again.
The request to the motion controller to take or release the configuration hold failed. Collect the logs and report it.
The cell's motion controller process is not available or has exited. Check the cell status and restart the workbench if it does not return.
A saved persistent Program value was dropped because the declaration of its key changed since it was stored. Set the value again if you still need it.

column2: Saved value dropped: key not persistent
column3: A saved persistent Program value was dropped because its key is no longer declared persistent. Declare the key persistent again if you need to keep the value.
An internal check failed: a frame path crosses active-control configurations that conflict for one control domain. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Active-control scope does not match path
column3: An internal check failed: the active-control expectations of a kinematic path do not exactly cover the path's control domains. Collect the logs and report it.
Two bindings that map to the same resource published different state, so the kinematic state is not consistent. Check the state sources of that resource.

column2: Coordinate maps to several path joints
column3: An internal check failed: a state-view coordinate maps to more than one joint of the retained frame path. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Planar or floating joint state unavailable
column3: Kinematic state for planar or floating joints cannot be projected yet, so the path state is unavailable.
An internal check failed: a state-view coordinate has no joint on the retained frame path. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a model coordinate projected from a kinematic state is not finite. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the active state sources map one model coordinate inconsistently. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Path coordinate has no state source
column3: An internal check failed: a path coordinate has no selected authoritative resource. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource's coordinate kind differs from the kind of its model coordinate. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Resource bound to two control domains
column3: An internal check failed: one path resource binding maps to more than one control domain. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a kinematic coordinate dependency is incomplete or not in canonical order. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Joint dependencies do not match kind
column3: An internal check failed: a kinematic joint's dependencies do not agree with its coordinate kind. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Passive joint has no controlling component
column3: A passive joint on the path has no controlling component to supply its state, so the kinematic state is unavailable. Check the robot's component and model setup.
An internal check failed: the kinematic state evaluation time is negative. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a joint segment of the kinematic path lacks its model, joint or link names. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a model coordinate is repeated on the kinematic frame path. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the kinematic frame path is malformed or disconnected, or it is empty for a terminal other than the cell frame. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Kinematic path not rooted at cell
column3: An internal check failed: the kinematic frame path does not begin at a cell anchor. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Kinematic path ends at another frame
column3: An internal check failed: the kinematic frame path ends at a frame other than its terminal frame. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a kinematic state query is missing its bundle, graph revision or terminal frame, or has a negative time skew allowance. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Observed states too far apart in time
column3: The observed states of this path were received further apart in time than the allowed budget, so no coherent state is available. Wait for fresh states and try again.
An internal check failed: the state source projections do not exactly cover the dynamic resources of the path. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a kinematic state source's control bindings are incomplete or not in canonical order. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: State source not needed by path
column3: An internal check failed: a state source is registered for a binding that the path does not depend on. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a kinematic state source projection is incomplete or not in canonical order. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Observed state differs from path expectation
column3: The observed state no longer matches the state this path was evaluated against; the mismatched field is named in the details. Refresh the state and try again.
A resource on the path has no authoritative state yet, so the kinematic state is unavailable. Wait for its state source to report.

column2: Several observed-state sources for one frame
column3: An internal check failed: more than one active observed-state source covers a frame coordinate or resource. Collect the logs and report it.
A state source required by the path is not available, so the kinematic state cannot be read. Check that the robot component is Active and reporting.
An internal check failed: a scene-frame state view has mismatched model coordinates. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the kinematic state view cannot be given its canonical identity. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Motion not admitted by lane guard
column3: The lane guard does not admit motion on this arm, so the motion was not sent. Check the lane and arm state, clear what blocks it, then try again.
An internal check failed: a late-cancelled goal has no owning execution identity, so its journal row cannot be recorded. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a late goal cancellation did not name one unique active execution. Collect the logs and report it.
The late-cancel execution journal is unavailable, so late-cancelled goals cannot be recorded yet.
