The runtime-scale command does not match the active binding. Refresh and try again.
The runtime-scale command is malformed. Collect the logs and report it.
A new operation must start its runtime scale at generation zero. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the resolved scene does not match its transaction. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop base plan could not be read
column3: An internal check failed: a stored Stop base plan could not be read. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a Stop base plan identity does not match its content. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a Stop base plan is incomplete or inconsistent. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop base plan cannot be encoded
column3: An internal check failed: a Stop base plan could not be encoded in its standard form. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop base plan is not in standard form
column3: An internal check failed: stored Stop base plan data is not in its standard form. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Stop plan storage reached its size limit. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: two different Stop plans were stored under the same identity. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop plan storage used from wrong process
column3: An internal check failed: the Stop plan storage was used from a process it does not belong to. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a stored Stop plan failed verification. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Stop plan storage failed unexpectedly. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Stop plan storage location or limits are invalid. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop plan storage could not be written
column3: A file operation on the Stop plan storage failed. Check the disk space and permissions of the workbench, then collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a Stop stage requested a Stop command the robot interface does not support. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop stage has no valid timing
column3: An internal check failed: a Stop stage has no valid per-robot Stop timing. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop stage does not match the sent motion
column3: An internal check failed: a Stop stage does not match the motion that was sent to the robot. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop stage cannot be tied to the sent motion
column3: An internal check failed: a Stop stage could not be tied to the motion currently sent to the robot. Collect the logs and report it.
Kernel operation admission has no exact bound resource table. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: only free, unowned resources can be marked as orphan-unreconciled, but a resource in the scope was reserved, owned or in use. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the orphan-resource reconciliation named an outdated resource table generation. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the orphan-resource reconciliation scope has duplicate, unsorted or invalid resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: orphan-resource reconciliation needs resources that are exactly unowned and orphan-unreconciled, and a resource in the scope was not. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource reservation was requested with an invalid owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the resource owner does not match the one holding the resource (for a cancelled preparation, it lost its exact resources). Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource owner revision did not advance monotonically. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owners of a coordinated resource release are duplicated or unsorted. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a row of a coordinated resource release is empty, unsorted or has duplicate resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scopes of a coordinated resource release overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: only a reserved or terminal resource can be released, and a resource in the scope was in another state. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owners of a coordinated resource reservation are duplicated or unsorted. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the participants of one coordinated reservation disagree on their operation revision. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a coordinated resource reservation has no owners or more owners than resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a row of a coordinated resource reservation is empty, unsorted or has duplicate resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scopes of a coordinated resource reservation overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owners of a coordinated resource revision update are duplicated or unsorted. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a coordinated resource revision update does not advance one valid operation. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a row of a coordinated resource revision update is invalid or names another operation revision. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scopes of a coordinated resource revision update overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
One or more of the resources the operation needs are not free, usually because another motion or operation is still using them. Wait for it to finish or stop it, then try again.
An internal check failed: a resource scope is empty or larger than the resource inventory. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource scope contains an empty or duplicate resource. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a cell admission resource scope has duplicate, unsorted or invalid resource identities. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource scope names a resource that does not exist in the inventory. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the rows of a batch Stop fence are duplicated, unsorted or invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: one operation has inconsistent owner revisions in a batch Stop fence. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the orphan scope of a batch Stop fence is not made of unowned, orphan-unreconciled resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owner scope or revision of a batch Stop fence is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the orphan scope of a batch Stop fence is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the resource scopes of a batch Stop fence overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a batch Stop fence has an invalid generation or number of scopes. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource in a batch Stop fence is not reserved, dispatched or terminal. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Stop generation of a batch Stop fence does not advance past the one already recorded for the resource. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource ownership transfer would change the physical binding or configuration of the owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource ownership transfer reuses the operation identity of a resident operation. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource ownership transfer used an unsupported mode. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owners of a resource ownership transfer are not a bounded, sorted, duplicate-free set. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a row or scope of a resource ownership transfer is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource ownership transfer leaves out part of the scope held by the current participant. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scopes of a resource ownership transfer overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource ownership transfer differs from the exact resource state it was prepared against. Collect the logs and report it.

An internal check failed: only dispatched resources can move ownership and only terminal resources can settle ownership, and a resource in the scope was in another state. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the target owner of a resource ownership transfer is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the owners of a coordinated resource transition are duplicated or unsorted. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a row of a coordinated resource transition is empty, unsorted or has duplicate resources. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scopes of a coordinated resource transition overlap. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resource was asked to move to a state that is not allowed from its current one. Collect the logs and report it.
Resume could not plan because the fresh current robot state could not be read. Check that the robot and its state feedback are connected and healthy, then try again.
The contact input could not resume and was left disabled. Check its source, then try again.
The contact input cannot resume from its saved baseline because it is disabled or the baseline is out of date. Refresh the view and try again.
An internal check failed: a forward kinematics request names a robot or target other than the retained one. Collect the logs and report it.

A frame needed for collision checking could not be resolved in the retained robot model. Check that the frame exists in the robot description, then try again. If it does, collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a joint-limit query names a robot or target other than the retained one. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a joint-name query names a robot or target other than the retained one. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the neutral joint state of the retained robot could not be projected for collision checking. Collect the logs and report it.
The render coordinates belong to another retained binding than the current one, so they were refused.

column2: Render coordinates do not match joints
column3: The render coordinates were refused: they must be finite and name each retained joint exactly once.
The retained target has no render coordinates yet.

column2: Observed state not for retained target
column3: The observed state does not match a retained target of the current configuration, so it was not used.
An internal check failed: a retained state binding is not registered with the kinematic projector. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the retained robot state channel cannot publish in bounded mode. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the retained robot state channel cannot be read in bounded mode. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Native state shape does not match target
column3: The native robot state does not have one value per retained joint, so it was not published. Check the robot's joint setup.
The native route needs a fresh state sample for its current binding, and none has arrived yet. Wait for the robot to report its state.
The kinematic model rejected the state of a mimic joint because it differs from the retained coordinate projection. The previous state was restored.
An internal check failed: projecting the robot state into RoboPlan failed, and the previous state was restored. Collect the logs and report it.
The latest robot state could not be projected into the candidate model, so the model change was not applied.
An internal check failed: no candidate kinematic state projector was supplied for the model change. Collect the logs and report it.
The candidate model does not register this state source's current target, so the model change was not applied.
An internal check failed: a retained model coordinate index no longer exists in the kinematic model. Collect the logs and report it.
Reading the kinematic model's state failed with an error, so no state was returned. Collect the logs and report it if this repeats.
An internal check failed: the kinematic model rejected a state projection and its previous state could not be restored. Collect the logs and report it.
The state route is being rebound right now, so this projection was not attempted. Try again.
The native route-state binding could not be kept for the new configuration, so the route change was not applied.
An internal check failed: the static collision bodies of the retained robot could not be projected. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retired participant engine was expected but is absent. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant engine that was retired is still registered by a participant. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a retired participant engine has no subscription to release. Collect the logs and report it.
The robot controller's service isn't available or refused the call; the details give the reason. Check the robot driver and controller, then try again.

The robot controller did not answer in time. The component is faulted and motion is blocked. Check the robot controller, its power and its network link, then Recover the component once it answers again.
Couldn't clear the robot error. If the e-stop is pressed, release it, then Recover the machine and Enable the arm.
The e-stop is still active, so the robot error couldn't be cleared. Release the e-stop (and the control box's emergency input), then Enable again.
The robot exposes no flange TCP, so it cannot be used for motion. Check the robot's component definition.

column2: Joint named twice in robot state
column3: An internal check failed: a robot state names the same joint more than once. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a robot state joint index is out of range for the model. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Joint names and positions differ in count
column3: An internal check failed: a robot state has different counts of joint names and positions. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Unnamed joint positions do not match
column3: An internal check failed: a robot state without joint names does not match the planning group size. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a robot state names a joint that is not a single-value joint. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a robot state names a joint that is not in the robot model. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a robot state has no joint positions. Collect the logs and report it.
No arm controller is bound to this component, so the step could not run. Check that its driver is running, then Prepare the component.
The ROS controller binding changed while its new epoch was being built, so the new epoch was not installed.
The controller binding counter ran out of values, so the controller cannot be rebound. Collect the logs and report it.
The trajectory controller is active although the component was not Enabled, so the change was refused. Check the robot's controllers before any further motion.
The trajectory controller is not loaded in the controller manager, so the component cannot be enabled. Check that the robot's driver and controllers are running, then Prepare the component.
The trajectory controller must be switched off before the arm's hardware changes, and it is still active. Disable the component, then try again.
The gripper is still executing or has a command in progress, so the lifecycle step could not start. Wait for the gripper command to finish and try again.
The request to cancel the gripper command could not be sent while disabling the gripper. Check the gripper and its driver before continuing.
A previous gripper cancellation has not reached a confirmed outcome. Check the gripper and its driver; Recover or restart the component if it stays.
The gripper command connection for this gripper is not configured. Check the gripper component configuration and Apply again.
The gripper command connection is not ready yet. Check that the gripper driver is running and the component is started.

column2: Gripper type cannot be disabled here
column3: An internal check failed: disabling this gripper requires the ROS gripper action connection, which it does not use. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper controller is active although the gripper was not requested Active, so the change was refused. Check the gripper before any further motion.
An internal check failed: the gripper controller is not in the arm's controller manager and hardware, or its Mock reset target does not match. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper controller is not loaded on active hardware in the controller manager, so the gripper cannot be activated. Check the gripper's driver and controllers, then Prepare the component.
No gripper controller is bound to this component, so the gripper change was refused. Check that its driver is running, then Prepare the component.
An internal check failed: the gripper display channel does not name the current gripper binding, so it was not attached. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the gripper display has no current single-value gripper state channel to read from. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper's command owner is not configured and ready, so the gripper change was refused. Check that the gripper component is running, then try again.
An internal check failed: the gripper-only transport does not have its exact binding, controller or clock. Collect the logs and report it.
The ROS gripper route publication does not match the physical gripper owner, so the route rebind was refused.
An internal check failed: a ROS runtime handle was bound a second time. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the ROS runtime was given a binding without its exact physical joints and arm controller details. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the ROS runtime's clock owner is not its exact receiver clock. Collect the logs and report it.
The ROS runtime is closing, so the request was refused. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

column2: Motion and gripper share a domain
column3: An internal check failed: the motion and gripper bindings name the same control domain. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the ROS runtime could not create a valid Core participant. Collect the logs and report it.

The runtime handle to the ros2_control controller was retired, usually because the configuration was changed or reloaded, so the motion was not sent. Apply the configuration again and retry the motion.
The hardware state change was cancelled. If it was already sent, its effect on the robot is unknown, so check the robot before any further motion.
The controller manager's hardware state service is not available, so the change was not sent. Check that the robot's driver is running, then try again.

column2: Hardware state change got no answer
column3: The hardware state change got no answer in time, so whether it took effect is unknown. Check the component state before continuing.
The hardware state client is not started, or the ROS runtime closed before the change was sent. Check that the robot's driver is running, then try again.

column2: Lifecycle step not supported by driver
column3: The driver of this component has no such lifecycle step; nothing was sent to it. Check the component package or report it.
A measured joint position is missing or not a valid number. Check the robot driver and its joint state output.
No current measured joint state was received from the robot, or none since the hardware was activated. Check that the robot and its driver are running and connected.
The robot component provides no measured joint state. Check the robot component configuration.
The ROS motion route publication does not match the physical arm owner, so the route rebind was refused.

column2: Controller owner did not stop in time
column3: The ROS controller owner did not finish stopping before its lifecycle deadline, so the change was refused.
A process-only binding needs its controller manager, hardware component and clock, and no controller name, so the binding was refused.
The trajectory controller's action server was not found after it was re-armed. Recover the component.
The driver did not reactivate the trajectory controller and the joint state broadcaster in time. Recover the component.
The controller switch was cancelled before its answer arrived, so its effect on the controllers is unknown. Check the robot's controllers before any further motion.
The controller manager's switch service is not available, so the controllers were not switched. Check that the robot's driver is running, then try again.
The controller switch did not finish in time. If it was already sent, its effect is unknown, so check the robot's controllers before any further motion.
The controller switch client is not started, so the controllers were not switched. Check that the robot's driver is running, then Prepare the component.
An internal check failed: the ROS output alias table is empty, or an alias is missing, duplicated or has no live output driver. Collect the logs and report it.
A ROS output (such as a gripper or digital output) needs a resolved service and an actual host channel, and its configuration lacks them. Check the output's channel settings and Apply again.
An internal check failed: ROS output aliases disagree on their driver lifetime or observation. Collect the logs and report it.
Another output provider already drives this GPIO channel (same group and interface). Give each output its own channel in the configuration and Apply again.
The ROS output service address differs from the one sealed at Apply, for example because it was remapped afterwards. Remove the remapping or Apply the configuration again.
The ROS executor of the component's connection failed, so the component faulted. Check the logs, then Recover.

column2: Component ROS connection did not stop
column3: The failed ROS connection of the component did not stop in time, so it was not rebuilt. Check the logs, then Recover again.
An internal check failed: the configuration hold of this request was already released. Collect the logs and report it.
The configuration hold operation failed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration hold release names a missing or different hold. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the configuration hold request names a different hold. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the controller route configuration could not be read consistently. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the controller route configuration could not be resolved. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper route of the previous configuration does not match its retained command binding, so it was not adopted. Check the gripper component and Apply again.
An internal check failed: the cell builder for the previous gripper route did not return a result. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the gripper route of the previous configuration was offered for adoption without its exact route or cell builder. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the previous gripper route has no route-rebindable owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the adopted gripper route did not read back command-closed, or its readback failed. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper of the previous configuration could not be reconnected during the configuration change. Check the gripper component and Apply again.
The gripper of the previous configuration could not be reconnected, and the rollback that followed also failed. Check the gripper component and collect the logs.
An internal check failed: a durable route predecessor has no exact control path to rebind. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a rebound route predecessor could not be sealed as a valid runtime binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a durable route predecessor does not match its retained runtime binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime Program alias differs from its previous physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime Program alias could not be rebound to its new physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a rebound runtime Program alias differs from its new physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Route representative has no sole backend owner
column3: An internal check failed: a rebound control representative does not have a sole backend owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the cell Kernel candidate does not contain exactly one exact gripper registration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a scalar route transition lost its exact cell owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the stable cell owner supplied an empty Kernel registration set. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a native route publication was given an invalid configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper backend could not be rebound to the new route during the configuration change. Check the gripper component and Apply again.
The retained gripper no longer has a current control path, so its route could not be published. Check the gripper component and its controller, then Apply again.
An internal check failed: the cell Kernel candidate builder did not return a result while publishing a gripper route. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a reconciled gripper publication has no stable cell owner to build the Kernel registration set. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the gripper route does not match the control domain of its retained configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Kernel did not retain the fail-closed, unreconciled gripper route. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Gripper route could not be closed
column3: The gripper route change failed, and the route could not be returned to a closed state either. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Kernel readback of the reconciled gripper route differs from what was published, or could not be read. The route was closed. Collect the logs and report it.
A gripper route change failed and the rollback to the previous route also failed. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the retained gripper owner did not restore its exact previous route. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the gripper route publication does not cover exactly the installed gripper bindings. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a reconciled gripper publication has no retained route-rebindable state channel. Collect the logs and report it.
The gripper state channel could not be rebound to the new route during the configuration change. Check the gripper component and Apply again.
An internal check failed: an unreconciled gripper route publication carries readiness participants. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Kernel readback of an unreconciled gripper route differs from its closed publication. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the Kernel's readback of a native route differs from the route it published, so the route change was rolled back. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a native route read or publication has no stable Kernel owner. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Motion backend could not follow route
column3: The motion backend could not be moved to the new route, so the route change was rolled back. Check the robot components and try again.

column2: Motion state channel could not follow route
column3: The motion state channel could not be moved to the new route, so the route change was refused. Check the robot components and try again.
An internal check failed: composing the native route publication raised an error. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a route readiness participant differs from its publication row. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a reconciled route publication has an incomplete or unexpected set of readiness participants. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the execution host has several physical owners for one binding. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Route readiness participant has no sole representative
column3: An internal check failed: a route readiness participant has no sole control representative. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a selected physical binding has no registration, or was not supplied to its route publication. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a scalar route no longer names its installed physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: route readiness omits one selected physical binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an unreconciled route publication contains readiness participants. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the readiness record of a robot control route is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
Cell authoring is not ready: a ROS route recovery is pending, so new admissions are refused until it finishes.
Selecting robot control routes needs the components to be started or Active, but at least one is disabled. Start the components and try again.
A global interrupt rule holds its scope: its condition still holds after its Stop, or it can't watch its signals. It clears by itself.
The Program names a global interrupt rule that isn't in the Deployment.
A Program run is already in progress.
The new configuration would change the control configuration of a robot that is currently in use, so it was refused. Wait for the motion to finish or stop it, then Apply again.
The exact bound target of the program could not be resolved in the runtime. Check that the target exists in the current configuration, then try again. The message gives the detail.

column2: Too many lifecycle steps in progress
column3: The component start was refused because too many lifecycle steps are already in progress. Wait for them to finish and apply again.
An internal check failed: the runtime collision-body alias table is incomplete or ambiguous. Collect the logs and report it.
A body allowed for contact grasping has no unique exact physical collision body. Check the contact-grasp body bindings in the configuration and Apply again.

The collision world has more bodies than the collision engine is qualified to check at runtime, so the collision monitor stopped motion. Reduce the number of collision bodies or use a larger qualified engine, then Reset.
An internal check failed: the published collision bundle has an invalid lookup order, and the collision monitor stopped motion. Collect the logs and report it.
Motion without a fault Stop profile needs a qualified controller-goal cancel, and this controller has none. Configure a fault Stop profile or use a controller whose cancel is qualified.
The runtime collision lookahead reported on the moving robot; the details give its result and reason.
The runtime collision monitor reported a problem; the details give the specific reason.
The runtime collision monitor could not be prepared; nothing was sent. Reset is required.
An internal check failed: the joint mapping of the runtime collision projection is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the runtime collision projection has an invalid shape or non-finite values. Collect the logs and report it.
An observed joint is absent from the collision query joints, so the state cannot be projected. Check that the robot model and the collision model use the same joint names.
The collision state projection cannot be built because the collision query has no joint names. Check the collision model and Apply again.
The collision state projection cannot map observed positions because they carry no joint names. Check that the robot state feedback publishes joint names.
An internal check failed: the collision state projection cannot be built without a template waypoint. Collect the logs and report it.
The observed state has a different number of joint names and positions than the collision projection expects. Check the robot state feedback and joint configuration.
The collision template trajectory does not match the number of collision query joints. Check that the robot model and collision model agree, then Apply again.
The runtime collision state projection is unavailable, so the motion was not collision checked and not sent. Check the collision configuration and Apply again.
The runtime collision query time budget is below the engine's qualified worst-case execution time. Increase the query timeout or use a faster qualified engine.
The configured collision engine is not admitted for runtime safety queries. Select a collision engine qualified for runtime queries.
The runtime collision projection has more joints than the engine's qualified joint bound. Reduce the joints in the collision query or use an engine qualified for more.
The runtime collision query could not be prepared, so the motion was not sent. The details give the prepare status. Check the collision configuration and try again.
An internal check failed: the runtime collision query session is missing while the collision monitor runs, and the monitor stopped motion. Collect the logs and report it.

No collision world snapshot has been published yet, so the runtime collision monitor cannot check motion. Wait for the collision world to be ready, then try again. If it persists, collect the logs and report it.
The collision world snapshot could not be prepared for runtime queries. The details give the prepare status. Check the collision model and try again.
Summary of how fully the runtime collision monitor covered stopping during the last monitored motion. No action needed.
A capability command lacks its exact runtime command schema or resource path. Check the component's command schema and resources, then Apply again.
The coordinate unit of a capability command differs from the units of its resources. Check the component's command and resource definitions.
The command schema of a runtime participant is missing its id or revision. Check the component definition and Apply again.
The stored Manager state predates this version and a clean start of the Manager state is required. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a component-set transition is outside its exact Apply fence. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a component-set transition has an incomplete product identity (bundle and graph revision). Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the participants of a component-set transition differ from the candidate product. Collect the logs and report it.
Committing the component-set publication failed under the Apply fence. Admission stays closed and the Apply fence stays held, so no motion is accepted. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a component-set transition changes a participant outside the Apply fence. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Component set has no fence scope
column3: An internal check failed: a component-set transition has no exact Apply fence scope. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime of the new configuration could not be finalized.
The runtime of the new configuration could not be prepared.
The runtime of the new configuration could not be verified.
An internal check failed: the candidate configuration staging has no installed control domain fact. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the candidate configuration being staged crosses the retained revision of its control domain, so it was not staged. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal failure occurred while staging the candidate configuration in the runtime, so it was not staged. Collect the logs and report it.
The candidate configuration is not covered by its Apply fence, so it was not staged. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Configuration staging has no admission gate
column3: An internal check failed: the runtime has no durable admission gate for staging the candidate configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scope of the candidate configuration staging is empty or invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the grasp contact bindings of a runtime participant are incomplete, unsorted or inconsistent. Collect the logs and report it.
The active contact policy of the runtime collision check is invalid, so grasp contact cannot be checked. Correct the contact policy.
The active contact policy of the runtime collision check is not one the runtime knows. Choose a known contact policy.
An internal check failed: a contact entry of the runtime collision check has no collision pair, so the trajectory could not be checked and nothing was sent. Collect the logs and report it.

An internal check failed: a runtime interface list is not valid. Collect the logs and report it.

An internal check failed: a runtime interface requirement could not be encoded. Collect the logs and report it.

An internal check failed: the collision world or policy data used by the trajectory lookahead is incomplete, so the trajectory could not be checked and nothing was sent. Collect the logs and report it.

The runtime trajectory lookahead did not finish its collision check within its cycle deadline, so the trajectory could not be certified and the motion was stopped or refused. Try again; if it persists, reduce the scene complexity or Collect the logs and report it.

The runtime trajectory lookahead could not certify the upcoming trajectory as collision free, so the motion was stopped or refused. Try again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.

The collision policy needed by the trajectory lookahead is not available, so the trajectory could not be checked and nothing was sent. Reset is required if it persists; Collect the logs and report it.

A collision query of the runtime trajectory lookahead exceeded its time budget, so the trajectory could not be certified. Try again; if it persists, reduce the scene complexity or Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime trajectory lookahead could not read the latest collision world revision, so the check result could not be confirmed. Try again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
The collision world changed while the runtime trajectory lookahead was checking, so its result is outdated and was discarded. Try again.

The collision engine could not prepare the world snapshot for the runtime trajectory lookahead, so the trajectory could not be checked. Reset is required if it persists; Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the model bindings of a runtime participant are incomplete or duplicate. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the model groups of a runtime participant are incomplete or duplicate. Collect the logs and report it.
Motion stopped: the robot's position feedback was lost during motion; this is not a detected collision. Check the robot controller, its connection and its component status before you continue.

An internal check failed: a motion endpoint is outside the exact motion component or model of its participant. Collect the logs and report it.

Set TCP was refused because the TCP has no exact runtime mapping on this robot, or the motion participant mapping is incomplete. Apply the configuration again with the TCP defined on this robot; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a motion participant selects a trajectory resource that is not angular. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Object bindings do not match references

More than one runtime participant matches the operation, so it was refused. Check the configuration for duplicate components or targets.
An internal check failed: a runtime participant has no exact execution binding identity. Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because its runtime participant has no active control path. Check that the component is enabled and the configuration applied, then try again.
An internal check failed: the resolved participant has no registered execution engine, so the operation was refused. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a product-backed participant selected an execution engine that is not pinned. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime participant has an empty required identity. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime participant has neither a control path nor a provider path. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resolved Program participant matches more than one physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because its runtime participant has no sealed motion policy. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because its runtime participant has no prepared execution engine. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
The operation does not name exactly one participant in the active retained product, so it was refused. Apply the current configuration and try again.
An internal failure occurred while resolving the operation's participant in the active product, so it was refused. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime participants of the candidate configuration are invalid, so it was not applied. Correct the configuration, or if the cause is unclear, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal failure occurred in the product-backed participant resolver, which returned no result. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a product-backed participant selected a resource outside the active resource inventory. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop base plan does not match its path

column2: Stop readiness: base plan not verified
column3: An internal check failed: at bind, the base Stop plan could not be verified. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant Stop readiness has an invalid component lifecycle generation. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: at bind, the Stop participant has no control path. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Stop controller domain does not match
column3: An internal check failed: a participant Stop readiness controller domain does not match its binding, path, or plan. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant Stop readiness refers to a different expected controller domain. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant nominal Stop scope does not match its resources or plan. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant nominal Stop target does not match its runtime path or plan. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Program participant has no physical owner
column3: An internal check failed: a resolved Program participant has no matching composed physical owner. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a product Stop rebind changed the controller of a participant. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the stop readiness of a Program participant could not be built. Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because its runtime participant has no verified Stop readiness. Wait for the component to become ready or apply again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.

The runtime event subscription table of the candidate configuration reached its capacity, so it was not applied. Reduce the number of components in the configuration or Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime could not subscribe to the events of a participant of the candidate configuration, so it was not applied. Collect the logs and report it.
No active runtime participant exactly matches the operation, so it was refused. Check that the component is enabled and the configuration applied, then try again.
The new runtime product could not be committed, so admission of operations stays closed. Reset is required; Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime profile differs from the running configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a resolved Program participant widens or crosses the physical runtime owner it is composed with. Collect the logs and report it.
The operation has no exact generated Program Binding in the active product. Apply the current configuration and run again.
The operation has no exact canonical Program in the active product. Apply the current configuration and run again.
An internal check failed: the runtime state read from its owner is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime state could not be read from its owner. Check the cell status and try again.
An internal check failed: a capability provider does not join exactly one runtime unit epoch. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the provider path of a runtime participant is incomplete or does not match its capability. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the resources of a runtime participant are incomplete or duplicate. Collect the logs and report it.
The candidate runtime resource inventory exceeds the maximum number of resources, so it was not applied. Reduce the number of robots or joints in the configuration.
An internal check failed: the candidate runtime inventory is not in canonical form. Collect the logs and report it.
The candidate configuration removes a resource that is still in use, so it was not applied. Wait for the motion to finish or stop it, then apply again.
An internal check failed: runtime aliases disagree on the readiness row of one selected binding. Collect the logs and report it.
The active configuration of the route publication is not valid, so it was not published. Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because there is no current reconciled route configuration yet. Wait until the configuration is applied and reconciled, then try again.
Route readiness requires one reconciled active configuration, and it is not reconciled. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime route current-fact query has an empty domain identity. Collect the logs and report it.
The durable previous route configuration does not match the current runtime binding, so it was not reused. Collect the logs and report it.
The readback of the durable previous route configuration could not be staged. Collect the logs and report it.
The durable previous route configuration is not one reconciled configuration, so it was not reused. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime registrations of the durable previous route configuration are invalid. Collect the logs and report it.
The durable previous route configuration differs from its runtime registrations. Collect the logs and report it.
The durable previous route configuration has no runtime participant. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the route-publication inventory is not in canonical form. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime registration changed before the route publication readback completed, so the publication was refused. Apply again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
The operation was refused because the route configuration has not been published since the last reconfiguration. Wait for the configuration to finish applying, then try again.
The runtime route readback could not be staged before publication. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime route configuration readback is absent or stale. Apply the configuration again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime route readback query has an invalid identity. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: runtime readiness does not cover every selected control binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the runtime readiness projection has an invalid shape. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the runtime Stop readiness differs from the published route configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a runtime registration differs from the published route configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: an unreconciled route publication cannot install runtime participants. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a participant engine returned a speed scale acceptance that does not match the request. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the speed change counter reached its maximum, so the speed change was refused. Collect the logs and report it.
The applied-state acknowledgement of a speed scale change is outdated, so it was not accepted. Set the speed scale again.
More than one active motion matches the scope of the speed scale control, so it was frozen. Change the speed scale for one motion scope at a time.
The capacity for speed scale settings is exhausted, so the change was refused. Wait for running programs to finish and try again.
An internal limit was reached: the speed scale control can take no further changes. Collect the logs and report it.
The speed scale request is malformed: the scale must be a finite number from 0 to 1 and the request must carry valid attribution. Correct the request and try again.
The speed scale target resolves to more than one control scope, so it was refused. Select a single target.
The speed scale selector is missing its Program binding, component or command target. Complete the selector and try again.
The speed scale control is frozen while a Stop is active. Clear the Stop, then set the speed scale again.
The speed scale target is absent from the current Program Binding. Select a target of the current Program.
The speed scale control is not currently available, so the change was refused. Wait until a motion is running and no Stop is active, then try again.
The speed scale target has no qualified control binding, so speed scale cannot be set for it. Select a target that supports speed scale.
The outcome of a speed scale change on a participant is unknown, so it cannot be relied on. Check the robot state and set the speed scale again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
A participant rejected the speed scale change. Set the speed scale again; if it persists, Collect the logs and report it.
An internal limit was reached: the speed scale can take no further changes. Collect the logs and report it.
A synchronized motion of several robots can only be slowed or sped up through its group velocity control, which is not available, so the motion is frozen. Use the group velocity control.
The group velocity targets name the same control scope more than once, so the speed change was refused. Name each control scope once.
The velocity group overlaps a different active execution scope, so the motion is frozen for speed changes. Wait for the other motion to finish or stop it.

column2: Group motion cannot change speed now

The execution mechanism of this motion has no qualified runtime speed scaling status, so its speed cannot be changed while it runs.
The runtime speed change request is malformed (missing identity or revision, or a scale outside 0 to 1). Send a scale between 0 and 1 for a current operation.

column2: Speed change not possible for ended motion
column3: Runtime speed scaling is not accepted because the execution has already ended or is ending.
The runtime speed status query does not name the active control binding of the operation. Query the active binding.
An internal check failed: the participant engine advanced a runtime speed generation that was not requested. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the participant engine returned runtime speed status for another binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the participant engine returned invalid runtime speed values. Collect the logs and report it.
The active binding has no accepted runtime speed generation yet, so there is no status to report. Request a speed change first.
The runtime speed status query has an empty operation or control binding identity. Name both.
The participant engine could not report its runtime speed status, so the speed change is marked failed.
The exact operation binding has no qualified runtime speed scaling, so the speed of this motion cannot be changed while it runs.
The ManyForge runtime is shutting down and refused the request.
An internal check failed: the supporting capability providers of a runtime are incomplete, unsorted or duplicated. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a prepared operation has an invalid list of runtime units. Collect the logs and report it.
The runtime unit differs from the running configuration. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a stored or exchanged record holds a value that is not a valid whole number. Collect the logs and report it.

The Scenario project or its folder changed while it was being read or saved. Try again.
A Scenario project file is invalid. The details give the reason.
The Scenario project or one of its files exceeds the size limit.
The target Scenario project already exists. Confirm the overwrite or choose another name.
The Scenario project path is invalid, missing, a link, or outside the allowed folders.
No folder is configured for Scenarios. Check the Composer settings.
The target is not a Scenario project folder, or a project member is not a regular file. Choose another target.
This Scenario uses an unsupported version or the removed parameter overrides file. The details explain how to update it.
Writing the Scenario project failed. The details give the reason.

The Deployment part of the Scenario is invalid. The details name the problem.
The Scenario folder is invalid or a link.
The Scenario folder does not exist.
The Scenario folder is outside the configured folders.
Loading would replace unsaved Program or Deployment Draft changes. Save them, or confirm that they can be discarded.
Every Draft already matches the applied configuration.
A Scenario asset file changed while it was being exported. Export again.
A Scenario asset is a link, not a plain file within the size limit, or could not be read.
Writing the exported project failed. The details give the reason.
An internal check failed: the export produced an unsafe file path. Collect the logs and report it.
The Scenario project has not been saved yet. Save it before exporting it.
The exported project could not be reopened from its own files, so it was not published.
The Scenario workspace was replaced, but the Manager's activation was not confirmed. Check the Manager status and refresh the workspace before retrying.
An internal check failed: the Manager did not report whether a configuration is applied, so Scenario Load was refused. Collect the logs and report it.
A model source used by the Scenario could not be captured. The details name it; check that the file is present.
A Scenario name may use letters, digits, '_' or '-', must start with a letter or digit and has a maximum length.
A Scenario is still applied. Start a New Scenario, then Load.
The Program draft stored in the Scenario project is invalid. The details name the problem.
A required file of the Scenario project is missing.
A Scenario project folder must be named <name>.scenario, with the same Scenario id and name inside.
The Untitled Scenario is read-only. Use Save As to save it in a folder.
The Scenario project contains an interrupted save. Check the project folder before opening it.
The Saved Deployment differs from the Applied one. Use the Deployment Revert to revert the whole Scenario.

An internal check failed: Scenario Save completed without reporting its file path. Collect the logs and report it.
A source referenced by the Scenario was added, removed or changed since it was saved. Review it and save the Scenario again.
The model sources of the Scenario's Deployment could not be collected. The details give the reason.
The authoring workspace changed while this request was prepared. Refresh and try again.
The native scene projection needed for the candidate scene preview could not be read. Try again; if it persists, collect the logs and report it.
A required native scene projection is not healthy at the predecessor of the candidate scene, so no preview was made. Wait for the projection to recover and try again.
The candidate scene preview only supports attaching or detaching a carried object. Use one of those operations.
The Scene edit preview is too large to send. Make the edit smaller or reduce the Scene size.
The candidate scene request names another Deployment or Scene than the active one. Reload and request the preview again.
Native scene-candidate projection is not installed in this runtime, so no candidate scene preview is possible.
The candidate scene request or its frame resolution is invalid. Correct the request.
The candidate scene request could not be reduced to its canonical form. Correct the request; if it persists, collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the scene candidate reducer produced an invalid successor scene. Collect the logs and report it.
The logical scene bootstrap is not finalized, so there is no live scene snapshot to preview against. Wait for the scene to finish loading and try again.
The logical scene projection is unavailable or changing, so scene writes are closed. Wait a moment and try again.
The scene still contains objects after clearing, because it changed meanwhile. Check the scene and clear again.
The scene changed while the motion was being validated.
The Scene could not be cleared. Check the listed reason and repeat New or Load.
Some objects remain in the Scene. Check the listed objects and reasons, then repeat New or Load.
A Scene transaction could not be confirmed. Inspect the Scene before repeating New or Load.

An internal check failed: the scene-frame resolution evidence could not be computed. Collect the logs and report it.
The native projection retained a different scene revision than requested. Try again; if it persists, collect the logs and report it.
More than one execution host unit claims to own this robot frame, so the frame cannot be resolved. Fix the configuration so only one unit owns it.
Scene frame resolution has no active native projection. Make sure the runtime is running and try again.
An internal check failed: a scene-frame query is invalid or differs from the active retained projection. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a native projection returned a malformed scene frame receipt. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Scene frame reference matches several frames
column3: An internal check failed: a scene-frame reference matches more than one retained path or carrier frame. Collect the logs and report it.
The referenced frame is not present in the applied component model.
Execution host units disagree on a static scene frame, so it cannot be resolved. Fix the configuration so all units agree.
The scene frame has no exact retained resolution, or the one found belongs to another scene. Reload and try again.
Native scene frame resolution is not installed in this runtime, so scene frames cannot be resolved.
An internal check failed: the scene-frame resolver produced an invalid result. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a scene-frame path crosses a component attachment that has no mapped revision. Collect the logs and report it.
The Apply failed while starting the Scene, and whether the Scene was changed is unknown. Check the cell status before continuing.
The requested mesh is no longer in the mesh cache. Upload or load it again.
The mesh exceeds the allowed file size or complexity. Simplify the mesh and upload it again.
The mesh file could not be converted. Check that it is a valid mesh file.
Converting the mesh took too long. Simplify the mesh and upload it again.
A scene mesh file could not be opened, for example because it has no approved scene asset root or is outside it. Check the mesh path and the scene asset location.
The scene object is not in the attached or detached state the request expected. Refresh the scene and try again.
The scene object is attached to a robot and carried, so it cannot be replaced or removed. Detach it first.
The object is not in the state this request expects.
It is not known whether the scene clearing finished. Check the scene before continuing.
The scene owner could not be reached while clearing the scene. Check that the runtime is running and try again.
An internal check failed: planning or collision components disagree on the effective collision policy. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a planning or collision component returned an altered collision policy. Collect the logs and report it.
The scene of the new configuration could not be adopted.
The scene of the new configuration could not be staged.

column2: Scene update for the Program failed
column3: The Scene refused or failed the Program's update request. The details name the cause.

A planning or collision component failed while applying the Scene edit, and its state is unknown. Check the Scene and component status before continuing.
The Scene changed before the pose could be resolved, so the pose was refused.
At least one planning or collision component cannot confirm the Scene state after the edit. Check the Scene and component status before continuing.
An internal check failed: a planning or collision component returned a contradictory confirmation for a Scene edit. Collect the logs and report it.
A Scene change was interrupted by a restart and its result could not be confirmed. Check the Scene and apply the change again if needed.
After a restart, every component was confirmed to still hold the previous Scene, so the Scene edit was not applied. Repeat the edit if still needed.
The removal order for the scene objects could not be worked out, so clearing failed. Check the scene attachments and try again.
An internal check failed: the user name attached to a Scene request is empty or invalid. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Scene change not carried out before restart
column3: A Scene change was accepted but the Scene owner restarted before it began applying it, so the change was not carried out. Submit it again if still needed.
The scene resources selected for the between-nodes latch are empty, duplicated or unsorted. Correct the selection.
A Program refers to a Scene resource that is not in the Scene. Correct the reference or add the resource to the Scene.
An internal check failed: a Scene revision number is out of range. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Pose source targets an old configuration
column3: The pose source refers to a configuration that is no longer active, for example after an Apply. The Isaac pose observer reconnects to the current one.

column2: Pose observation expiry out of range
column3: An internal check failed: a pose observation expiry time is out of range. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a pose observation does not match its registered binding. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a pose observation id was reused with different content. Collect the logs and report it.
The Manager cannot accept more pose source sessions. Reduce the number of pose sources.
An internal check failed: the pose observer session counter reached its limit. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: a pose observer session id was reused with different bindings. Collect the logs and report it.
The pose source session changed before the pose could be applied. The Isaac pose observer reconnects.

column2: Scene not ready for pose sources
column3: The Scene has no active configuration for pose sources yet. Wait until the configuration is active.
The active configuration could not be loaded to apply the pose. Check the cell status.
The Scene rejected the pose update from the pose source; the details give its reason. Check the pose source and the Scene.
An internal check failed: the Scene returned an invalid result for a pose update. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the evidence derived from the pose source is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Scene pose capture returned bad status
column3: An internal check failed: capturing the robot pose for planning returned an unexpected status. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Pose source object not in Scene
column3: The object that the pose source updates is not in the Scene. Add the object to the Scene or correct the pose source's object.

Planning needs a pose for this object, but its pose source has not reported one. Check that the pose source is running and sees the object.

column2: Pose from pose source too old
column3: Planning needs a fresh, good-quality pose for this object, but the pose source has none. Check that the pose source is running and sees the object.

column2: Pose not applied to the Scene
column3: Planning needs a pose for this object that was applied to the Scene, but none was. Check the pose source status.
The Scene is not open for pose updates, for example during start-up or Apply. Wait until the cell is ready.
The pose source sent a pose that cannot be decoded. Check the pose source's output.
An internal check failed: a pose observation uses an update policy that is not supported. Collect the logs and report it.
The Scene or configuration changed while the pose was being applied. The pose was not applied.
The pose source's provider binding for this cell is invalid. Check the pose source settings in the Deployment.

column2: Pose reference link not in model
column3: The reference link or carrier frame of the pose source is not a link of the robot model. Check the pose source reference settings.
A pose for an object held by the gripper needs the gripper's reference pose, which the pose source did not report. Check that the pose source sees the gripper.

column2: Pose reference not from one instant
column3: The pose source read the object and the holding body at different instants, so the pose was not used.

column2: Pose reference link not fixed to carrier
column3: The robot model has no fixed joint path between the pose reference link and the carrier frame, so the pose cannot be placed. Check the pose source reference settings.
The pose source has no pose of the object relative to its holding reference, so the pose was not used. Check that the pose source sees the object and its holder.
The pose reference of the attached object could not be resolved against the robot model. Check the pose source reference and the attachment.
The object or its attachment needed for this pose could not be found in the current Scene. Check the Scene object and its attachment.

column2: Object already updated by another source
column3: Another pose source already updates this object in the Scene. Configure only one pose source per object.

column2: Scene runtime time is in the future
column3: The Scene runtime data is stamped later than this computer's clock. Check the clock synchronisation of the workbench.

column2: Scene runtime data too old to measure
column3: The Scene runtime data is older than the supported age. Check that the Scene runtime is running.

column2: Scene runtime data not published yet
column3: The Scene runtime has not published its data yet. Wait for it to start.

column2: Scene runtime data from the wrong source
column3: The Scene runtime data comes from a source other than the expected owner. Check the running services.
The Scene runtime data received is invalid. Collect the logs and report it.

column2: Scene runtime data out of date
column3: The Scene runtime data is too old. Check that the Scene runtime is running.
The Scene runtime has no usable data. Check that it is running.

column2: Scene edit refers to an old Draft
column3: The Scene edit was made on a Draft that is no longer current. Reload the Draft and repeat the edit.
The participant scheduler calls did not finish in time while detaching, so the request was refused. Try again.

The first planned controlled Stop sample does not match the current path state, so this candidate is not used.
An internal check failed: a component start names a control binding outside the scope of its Apply. Collect the logs and report it.

The motion exceeds a joint, speed or acceleration limit.
An internal check failed: the validation version recorded with a motion is not valid. Collect the logs and report it.
A stored persistent value was dropped because it is no longer valid for its declaration. Set the value again.
An internal check failed: the robot model data for the 3D view is inconsistent or out of bounds. Collect the logs and report it.
The viewer has no model to show, because the Manager has no active configuration or the active configuration has no viewer model. Apply a configuration, then reload the view.
This execution host has no motion trace collector, or the trace could not be captured within its size limit.
The Manager heartbeat watchdog could not be scheduled. Collect the logs and report it.
A waypoint has a different number of positions than the trajectory has joints, so collision projection was refused. Correct the trajectory.
An internal check failed: a request to the 3D viewer worker was built with invalid fields. Collect the logs and report it.
The data for the 3D viewer worker exceeded its size limit and was not sent. Collect the logs and report it.
An internal check failed: the 3D viewer worker returned a malformed or corrupted reply. Collect the logs and report it.
The execution worker raised an unexpected exception. See the attached message. Collect the logs and report it.
The execution worker exited without recording how the motion ended. Collect the logs and report it.
The motion controller is shutting down its motion worker, so the request was refused. Wait for the lifecycle step to finish and try again.
An execution cannot be started from the active execution worker. Start it from a normal request.
A function in the expression is called with the wrong number of arguments. Correct the expression.
Only a computed completion can be acknowledged, and the execution is in another state. Wait until the motion has completed.
The robot's reported or measured joint angles are missing or invalid, so the robot controller was not activated. Check the robot connection and the xArm controller, then activate again.
A measured joint angle differs from the angle the xArm controller reports, so the robot controller was not activated. Check the robot and its joint readings, then activate again.
The xArm controller is not ready for commands (error, mode, state or motors not enabled), so the arm was not enabled. Recover the machine, then Enable the arm again.

The robot did not confirm a step of its re-engage (its mode or state change, or the state change after a TCP offset), so the motion was not started. Check the robot and its connection, then start the motion again; if it repeats, Recover the robot.

After its re-engage the robot did not report joint-servo mode and the ready state in time, so the motion was not started. Check the robot, then start the motion again; if it repeats, Recover the robot.
The xArm driver service call was cancelled before it finished.
The xArm driver service did not answer the call. Check the driver and the robot connection.
The xArm driver service returned a non-zero code, for example a controller error, and the call may still have taken effect. Read the robot state and clear the controller error.
The xArm driver service did not answer in time. Check the driver and the robot connection.
The xArm driver service was not discovered, so the call was refused before any effect. Check that the driver is running.
The xArm controller's status report is missing or out of date, or no report arrived after the driver restart. Check the connection, then Prepare or Recover the machine.
The motion stayed at zero speed longer than the allowed hold time and was ended. Raise the speed or restart the motion.
